Recommend NextCloud. Please refer to the binding process on their respective webpages.

Take NextCloud as an example, the account binding process is as follows:

1. On the NextCloud webpage, log in to your personal account, and you can find the WebDAV address of your personal account in the main interface of File - Settings;

2 Click the account avatar-Settings-Security-Device and activity link, enter any desired name, and click Create new app password, which is the authorized application password. This password will only be displayed once when it is created. Please save it safely and use it when binding an account

3. For more instructions, see: https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/20/user_manual/en/files/access_webdav.html



Binding account:

1. On the binding interface, enter the WebDAV address, account, and created App password to complete the binding;

2. If the authorization is withdrawn on the webpage, the device will automatically log out, and you need to apply for the App password and binding again before continuing to use it.
